Due to her pride and stubbornness, what was only a minor dispute with the demon realm had escalated into a full-blown economic war of attrition. Her kingdom near ruin, she offered herself up to the Demon Lord, in exchange for aiding its recovery. Now the Demon Lord's plaything, she serves him in anyway he pleases.
